description:
Track time against threads, billable and unbillable, in the vault's hours directory.

Subcommands:
  log THREAD DESCRIPTION... [-m MINUTES] [-r RATE] [-c ISO] [-d YYYY-MM-DD] [-t HH:MM] — append an entry
  list [THREAD] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--json] — list entries
  report [--thread THREAD] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--json] — totals by thread and currency, unbilled time totalled separately
  show ID [--json] — show one entry
  edit ID [--description TEXT] [-m MINUTES] [-r RATE] [-c ISO] [-d YYYY-MM-DD] [-t HH:MM] — change one field of an entry
  rm ID [-y] — delete an entry

Flags:
  log: THREAD is a thread name, 'Kind/Name', or wikilink; DESCRIPTION is the remaining words, a short invoice line item. -m duration in minutes, default 60; -r hourly rate, 0 means unbillable; -c ISO currency code, defaults to the thread's — with neither, the entry is recorded as unbilled; -d date, default today; -t time, default now. --all only affects the interactive form.
  edit: --description replaces the entry's description; other flags as for log.
  rm: -y skips confirmation.

Examples:
  ["log", "Projects/SGB", "DORA metric validation", "-m", "180", "-d", "2026-06-14"]
  ["list", "Projects/SGB", "--since", "2026-06-01", "--json"]
  ["report", "--since", "2026-06-01", "--until", "2026-06-30", "--json"]
  ["edit", "a1b2c3d4", "-m", "90"]

Notes:
  Never call `log` without THREAD — with no thread it enters interactive capture and reads from stdin.
  ID is the 8-hex-char entry id; the id namespace is shared with `payments`.
  Asking for a rate with no currency to express it in is refused; rate 0 is an ordinary value and the time still counts.
  Descriptions here are not searchable — `search` does not index hours. Put anything worth finding later into a log line via `buffer add-text`.
  Each logged entry also drops a REF into the buffer, filed under the work's date, which reaches the thread's daily log on the next `buffer flush`.
  `rm` permanently deletes the entry.
